goal: Deliver the finite competition CLI independently of PowerShell and Codex, preserving resource/budget protections.
changes: Python standard-library Windows Job backend replaces the production PowerShell backend; retain owner, same named mutex, suspended startup, exact identities, limits/readback, stopping, inventory and preview cleanup.
setup.cmd/bootstrap.py use ordinary Python 3.11+ on Windows x64; project uv/Python/dependencies remain pinned and local, uv sync --locked; production CLI uses its actual base interpreter.
configure creates cloud/application profiles without reading credentials or sending requests; doctor declares missing prerequisites without claiming device/build verification.
Installed CLI refuses env/all apply before dispatch; after it exits, setup.cmd --clean uses ordinary external Python and the reviewed plan.
Windows metadata and cleanup use extended I/O paths with canonical owner identities, unchanged ACL/registry and explicit evidence discard.
Managed tests reuse a separate mature pytest process in the same bounded Job, then reclaim only their new checked temporary tree.

validation.scope: Synthetic official SDK transport and toy application checks only.

totals.basis: 263/2 from preceding model/application package plus 95/0 from these four groups; latest result per group, not full-repository/effect evaluation.

external_cleanup.targets: explicit fake environment files in new synthetic deployments

first_failures.reason: Windows venv redirector child identity mismatch.
Exact diagnostic; allow verified redirector ancestry while retaining actual named Job membership/readback.
Test replaced Popen type before SDK/asyncio lazy import; preserve type and intercept constructor.
20 assertions passed but managed temporary-tree fingerprint rejected a 262-character Windows path; run receipt failed.
Separate pytest alone did not resolve the path error; 20 assertions passed but managed receipt failed. Long-path I/O fix required.
Incomplete-accounting mock intercepted normal path only; updated to intercept actual extended I/O without weakening required refusal.

limitations: No cache-free clean-machine installation certification; project distribution is Windows x64 complete source, not standalone wheel/cross-platform.
Real model ID, provider behavior, SDK/device/signing and first-case build/replay/business/regression runners require acceptance.
Synthetic checks do not establish fault localization accuracy, repair success, stability, token savings or paper contribution.
